title: CLCON/525/2017 of Prahlad Ram Arya Vs Sh. Chandra Shekhar Bhatt/dr. Bhupendra Kaur Aulakh AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLCON No.525 of 2017
U.C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Shiv Pande, Advocate for the
petitioner.
It is the submission of learned
counsel for the petitioner that order dated
24.4.2017 passed by a coordinate Bench of
this Court in WPSS No.2414/2015 has not
been complied with.
Respondent was directed to consider
the case of the petitioner in the light of
judgment rendered on 24.4.2017, which
has not been considered. It is the prayer of
learned counsel for the petitioner that an
informed decision be taken in the matter.
Instead of issuing contempt notice to
the respondent, a direction is given to the
respondent to comply with the order sought
to be executed and submit compliance
report by 15.12.2017, failing which the
Court will be constrained to initiate
contempt proceedings against the
respondent-alleged contemnor.
Contempt petition is disposed of by
directing the Registry to provide a copy of
this order to the petitioner, today itself, on
payment of usual charges to enable the
petitioner to serve a copy of this order upon
the respondent within a week.
(U.C. Dhyani, J.)
 07.11.2017
A.kaur
